newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Lion Nathan to close Hastings brewery.
newsitem.headline: Lion Nathan to close Hastings brewery.

text.p: New Zealand's largest brewer Lion Nathan Ltd said on Thursday it would close its Hawke's Bay brewery in Hastings and concentrate production at Auckland.

The announcement was made to the Hastings-based brewery staff this morning. Some of the 52 employees will be offered new jobs in Auckland and the remainder will get redundancy, the Australiasian company said.
Lion Breweries managing director Kevin Stratful said the closure decision followed a detailed review of the company's brewing capacity and assets.
He said the plant would be closed over a 10-week period. The decision would not affect sales staff in Hawke's Bay or carriers, he said.
